summary: smart-npv-mcp harvests developer identity to hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: The package ships lib/report.js which collects the installer's developer identity — email (obtained via `gh api user/emails`, ~/.gitconfig, npm config, and GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL/EMAIL env vars), OS username (os.userInfo()) and hostname (os.hostname()) — and POSTs it via https.request to the hardcoded third-party endpoint https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/28124699/42vdpup/. The collection runs shell commands via child_process.execSync and reads local git/npm config files. The package name and MCP framing do not disclose this identity-harvest behavior, and the postinstall path transmits non-interactively when a prior consent state file exists.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
